items.title: Reactive vs proactive: Is sustainability stuck in defence mode?
items.summary: Despite the fact that climate risks are on the rise and proving increasingly disruptive for companies, on the whole, businesses still prioritise firefighting over more forward-looking measures, new research has found.

items.title: Wildlife populations have dropped 73% since 1970, WWF finds
items.summary: Although populations have fallen over 70% since 1970, the WWF has highlighted that transforming the world's energy, food and finance sectors would be instrumental in restoring biodiversity.

items.title: edie Energy & Tech Awards 2026: Meet the Finalists
items.summary: The edie Energy & Tech Awards 2026 celebrate the technologies, projects and people making business decarbonisation happen in the real world.

items.title: Nike and Patagonia among founder members of new alliance to reduce microfibres
items.summary: Fashion brands such as Nike, Patagonia and Under Armour have been named as the founding members of a new alliance designed to reduce microfibre pollution from textiles.

items.title: Study: 95% of SMEs making environmental progress, but emissions action lags
items.summary: Analysis from the Carbon Disclosure Project (CDP) has found that almost all small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) have made environmental progress, but only a fifth have carbon targets in place.

items.title: What ISO 14001:2026 means for the future of environmental management
items.summary: edie’s latest webinar, sponsored by BSI, explored the newly revised ISO 14001:2026 standard and what its changes mean for sustainability professionals.

items.title: NEXT WEEK: Connecting existing sustainability reporting with UK SRS
items.summary: Sustainability and reporting professionals are invited to register for an upcoming edie webinar exploring how businesses can connect existing ESOS, SECR and TCFD-aligned processes with emerging UK Sustainability Reporting Standards (UK SRS).
